# mtncloud_workflows (Data Source)

Lists your workflows, including those made in the console. Provisioning and operational workflows.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_workflows" "all" {}

output "workflows" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_workflows.all.workflows : x.id => { name = x.name, name = x.name } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return workflows whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `workflows` (Attributes List) The workflows, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workflows))

<a id="nestedatt--workflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workflows`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `id` (Number) ID of the workflow.
- `labels` (List of String) Labels.
- `name` (String) Name of the workflow.
- `platform` (String) Platform it runs on, or empty for all.
- `tasks` (List of Number) IDs of the workflow's tasks, in order.
- `type` (String) `provision` or `operation`.
- `visibility` (String) `private` or `public`.
